headline: BNP MP Ferdousy Ahmed Mishti resigns following PM's directive
summary: The Parliament Secretariat has declared her seat vacant after she stepped down amid allegations of involvement in the attack on a healthcare centre.
details: Ferdousy Ahmed Mishti, a BNP MP elected to a reserved seat for women, has resigned from parliament. The Parliament Secretariat announced on Thursday that her seat was declared vacant on October 1 under Article 67(2) of the Constitution.
caption:
A BNP MP has resigned from parliament following a directive from the Prime Minister.

Ferdousy Ahmed Mishti, a BNP MP elected to a reserved seat for women, has resigned from parliament. The Parliament Secretariat announced on Thursday that her seat was declared vacant on October 1 under Article 67(2) of the Constitution.

caption:
4 more deaths and nearly 2,000 hospitalisations in just 24 hours. Dengue remains a critical threat.

Bangladesh has reported four new dengue deaths and 1,978 hospital admissions in the last 24 hours, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

The latest fatalities bring this year's total dengue death toll to 249. September has been the hardest-hit month, with 43,774 hospitalisations and 148 deaths recorded.

In the last 24-hour window, 180 patients were admitted in Dhaka North and 176 in Dhaka South, while 328 others were admitted across the Dhaka Division.

Other regional admissions include Chattogram with 358, Barishal with 260, Khulna with 256, Rajshahi with 209, Mymensingh with 94, Rangpur with 101, and Sylhet with 16.

A total of 1,809 patients were discharged from hospitals in the same period. So far this year, 81,598 people have been hospitalised, while 75,699 have recovered.

The DGHS has maintained records since 2000. The highest number of hospitalisations occurred in 2023, when 321,179 people were admitted and 1,705 died from the disease.
